description.value:
Duration constant

Whenever an Overflow effect you draw damages a construct or ghost-machine, that creature also takes a -1 status penalty to AC until the end of your next turn as its plating and joints corrode. This penalty does not stack with itself, and a construct repaired or cleaned of the corrosion loses it early.

cinderfall.incomplete: On any Overflow-damage hit against a construct, applies -1 AC to that hostile creature -- no generic 'after any damaging spell I cast hits a construct, apply an effect to it' hook exists (NOFOREIGN-ITEM-adjacent).
